subject: Request: Lumenix POC — increased trial credits for high-throughput use
messages:
From: Sara Albright <sara@lumenix.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Request: increased trial credits for Lumenix POC

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed. We are ready to move into a focused POC (customer-facing assistant for our support workflows) but the workload is heavier than a standard PLG trial. A few specifics:
- Model usage: long-context Llama-variant with ~64k context for retrieval-augmented responses
- Expected throughput: 1.2k–1.8k requests per minute during peak tests (~1.5k TPM)
- Estimated token consumption: ~1.2M tokens over a 30 day POC if we run the planned tests

The self-serve trial credits we received will be consumed in a couple of days unless we get an uplift. Can Redwood provide a short-term promotional credit/top-up (self-serve or promo code) and extend the trial window to 30 days so we can complete the evaluation? We can share the POC scope doc (attached) and a PO if required.

Appreciate any quick help — we’re aiming to close an internal approval by late October.

Thanks,
Sara Albright
Director of Engineering, Lumenix
sara@lumenix.ai
Attachment: lumenix-poc-scope.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-08T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Lumenix POC — request for larger trial allowance

Folks — forwarding a request from Lumenix. Key asks: bump trial credits and extend to 30 days because they expect high TPM and large context windows. They attached a POC scope.

Quick context: Lumenix looks like a fast-moving PLG account with potential expansion into Dedicated once the POC succeeds. They explicitly call out 64k contexts and ~1.5k TPM.

Proposal: a self-serve promotional grant (promo code) for X tokens/credits plus a 30-day window. I don’t want to over-commit — looking for guidance on appropriate uplift and any guardrails (SLA/limits).

Can you advise approved amount and whether we should require a signed MSA/PO?

— Olga

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lumenix POC — request for larger trial allowance

I support an uplift here. Given the numbers, suggest the following conservative, trackable grant:
- Promotional credit equivalent to 200k tokens (or token-value equivalent)
- Trial window extended to 30 days from issuance
- Throttle cap at account level set to 2k RPM for safety; automatic rollback if usage spikes beyond agreed thresholds

Operational notes: issue a promo code tied to their account, add a HubSpot deal note (see link below), and flag CS to monitor token burn and quality regressions. If they sign a PO/MSA we can convert into a Dedicated pilot commitment.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7523/54321

—Aditya
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lumenix POC — request for larger trial allowance

Approved with conditions:
- Grant: promo code for credits equivalent to 200k tokens; valid 30 days
- Rate limits: enforce 2k RPM cap and per-IP safeguards
- Security: require they complete our basic security questionnaire and confirm data retention settings before we enable the uplift in production; hold payment/PO conversion conversation if POC progresses.

Action items: Olga to issue promo, Priyom to add CS into onboarding, Aditya to update HubSpot and monitor.

Ben
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Albright <sara@lumenix.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Lumenix POC — increased trial credits for Lumenix POC

Hi Sara — good news. We approved a short-term promotional grant to help with the POC. Details below: 

- Grant: promotional credit equivalent to 200,000 tokens
- Validity: 30 days from issuance (promo expires 2026-11-17)
- Controls: account-level throttle 2k RPM; we will monitor usage and may pause if we detect extreme burst or misuse
- Next steps: please complete the short security questionnaire (link) and confirm retention policy; procurement can route PO to sales@redwood.ai if you want us to convert to a pilot contract.

Promo code: PCT-LUM-2026
Attachment: credit-grant-notice.pdf (contains issuance details and T&Cs)

If you need the code applied immediately, reply-all and we’ll enable it within 1 business hour after confirming the account email. We’ll also have CS (Priyom) reach out to kick off onboarding.

Thanks and excited to see the results — Olga

—
Olga Petrov
